seed_contract.derivation: Unsigned big-endian value of the first four SHA-256 bytes of the UTF-8 labels aurorapic-turner-corrected-confirmation-20260826-1 through -3.
seed_contract.selection_rule: All three derived values had zero exact repository occurrences outside ignored temporary/build trees before preparation. No simulation outcome from these seeds was observed before this rule.

primary_published_profile_acceptance.rationale: Requiring at least two of three independent members inside the published 95 percent interval and no member outside the 99 percent interval is a prospective ensemble robustness rule; Turner publishes individual-realization intervals, not this derived ensemble decision.

supplemental_integrity_acceptance.note: These are predeclared AuroraPIC engineering robustness screens, not Turner-published confidence intervals.

decision_rule.confirmation_passed: All three executions and provenance audits pass, at least two members pass the published 95 percent interval, all three pass the 99 percent interval, and every supplemental integrity gate passes.
decision_rule.published_profile_confirmed_but_suppleme: The primary published-profile ensemble rule passes but at least one supplemental integrity gate fails.
decision_rule.published_profile_confirmation_failed: Fewer than two members pass the 95 percent interval or any member fails the 99 percent interval.
decision_rule.execution_invalid: Any member is incomplete, non-finite, provenance-invalid, resource-invalid, or lacks the exact final averaging window.

claim_boundary: Passing would confirm that the corrected collision schedule yields robust code-to-code statistical consistency for three fresh full-length realizations of one 1D electrostatic helium CCP benchmark. It would not establish experimental validation, asymptotic numerical convergence, other gases, external geometries, multidimensional solvers, electromagnetic physics, or general predictive validity.
